question: Does association with great or minor sins exclude one from this salvific outcome?
premises: A person may be joined with great sins.
A person may alternatively be joined with minor sins.
Both conditions are presented as possible cases.
inference: Even those burdened by great or minor sins are included in the scope of the stated outcome.
uncertainties: The verse is syntactically incomplete and continues into the next verse.
plain_english: Whether joined with great sins or even with minor sins,
